hook_en: He is alive, and He is your Rock. 🙏
reflect_en: As this week comes to a close, look back and praise Him. David remembered every rescue and ended with worship: the God who delivered him then is living and steady for you today.
q_en: What has God carried you through this week?
x_en: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted
tiktok: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock 🙏 Psalm 18:46–48 — end your week with praise
yt_title: The LORD Lives, Blessed Be My Rock | Psalm 18:46-48 #Shorts
li_open: Before the week ends, name what you were delivered from.
li_quote: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted
li_body: David closes this song by remembering every rescue and giving God the credit. Leaders who pause to notice answered prayers, and celebrate them with the people they serve, build communities that keep praying with hope.
hook_es: Él vive, y es tu roca. 🙏
reflect_es: Al terminar la semana, mira hacia atrás y alaba a Dios. David recordó cada vez que Dios lo libró y terminó adorando: el mismo Dios que lo libró a él vive hoy y es tu roca firme.
q_es: ¿En qué te ha sostenido Dios esta semana?
x_es: Viva Jehová, y sea bendita mi roca; y ensalzado sea el Dios de mi salud
key_en: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock
key_es: Viva Jehová, y sea bendita mi roca
